data.name: Pure Carbon Partners (PCP)
data.description: Pure Carbon Partners (PCP) is a buyer-side carbon asset management and procurement advisor focused exclusively on durable carbon dioxide removal. The firm aggregates corporate demand to negotiate long-term offtake agreements with CDR suppliers, handling project evaluation, MRV scrutiny, and delivery management. It does not physically remove CO2 itself.
